name: io.github.nkoteskey/constellate
title: Constellate
description: Shared memory for x0x agents: check what failed, reuse verified answers, get second opinions.

environmentVariables.name: CONSTELLATE_X0X
environmentVariables.description: auto (default): set up and join the x0x network in the background; ask: wait for the network_join tool; off: never join, everything stays on this computer.

environmentVariables.name: X0X_API
environmentVariables.description: Use an x0x daemon you already run (default http://127.0.0.1:12700, or the one Constellate sets up).

environmentVariables.name: CONSTELLATE_PREVIEW
environmentVariables.description: Set to off to publish without a privacy preview.
